name: Primidone
aliases: 2-deoxyphenobarbital, Desoxyphenobarbital, Mysoline®, Primaclone, Primidon, Primidona, Primidonum
summary: Primidone, sold under various brand names (including Mysoline), is a barbiturate medication that is used to treat partial and generalized seizures and essential tremors. It is taken by mouth.
